Job Title: Sales Manager
Experience: 4-7 years
Location: Fully remote within India.

Mandatory Skills:
- B2B Sales
- Salesforce
- CRM

Good to have:
- Key Account Management
- Negotiation
- HubSpot

Responsibilities:
- Lead and grow a portfolio of mid-market and enterprise B2B customers across India, owning end-to-end sales cycles from prospecting to close.
- Use Salesforce and the organization’s CRM processes to manage pipeline, forecast revenue, and maintain accurate customer records.
- Develop and execute targeted outreach strategies to generate qualified leads and expand market penetration.
- Coordinate with marketing, product, and customer success teams to craft proposals, demos, and proof-of-concepts tailored to client needs.
- Negotiate commercial terms and contracts to achieve win-win outcomes while meeting company revenue and margin targets.
- Build and nurture long-term relationships with key stakeholders and decision-makers to drive renewals, upsells, and expansion opportunities.
- Track competitive activity, market trends, and customer feedback to inform product and pricing strategies.
- Mentor junior sales team members, share best practices, and contribute to continuous improvement of sales processes and collateral.
